title: Closed proper base change for finite-subextension-valued algebraic-closure coefficients
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$ isomorphic, as a monoid object in condensed abelian groups, to the finite-subextension-valued coefficient $\Omega^{\mathrm{fin}}$ of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]: its sections on a profinite set are continuous functions into $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ whose image lies in one finite subextension. Use pulled-back coefficients and ordinary unbounded derived internal module categories [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, $q:Y\to S$ proper, $f:X\to Y$ proper, and $c:C\hookrightarrow Y$ a closed immersion whose open complement is quasi-compact [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Put $X_C=X\times_Y C$, $a:X_C\to X$ and $f_C:X_C\to C$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. For every bounded constructible finite-Tor object $L\in D_{\mathrm{ctf}}(X,\Lambda)$, with finite constant scalar models as in [sk-def-sfb-constructible], the actual unit-square-counit mate [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] is invertible: $$c^*Rf_*L\xrightarrow{\sim}R(f_C)_*a^*L.$$ No open-support, field-base, characteristic, Noetherianity, density or finite-dimensional-base assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Transport along the coefficient-ring isomorphism by inverse exact scalar equivalences. These preserve finite presentations on the point, their pulled local models, homology bounds and Tor intervals. The geometric adjunctions and their actual units and counits transport, hence so does the exchange mate. This reduces to the canonical finite-subextension-valued coefficient.

Apply qcqs algebraic-closure integral generation on X. Each generator is scalar extension from O_F for a finite subextension F. Factor O_F -> Omega^fin through F, using derived scalar composition. Integral scalar extension puts the F-coefficient input in D_ctf. Closed pullback preserves this class; apply finite-rational closed proper base change.

The finite-field-to-algebraic-closure direct-image comparisons are invertible for f and f_C on these bounded-below inputs. The normalized scalar-geometric rectangle, with invertible scalar/pullback edges, identifies their conjugate with the scalar image of the finite-field exchange. Thus exchange is invertible on every generator.

Canonical shift compatibility and triangulatedness make the exchange isomorphism locus replete and closed under shifts and extensions. Every bounded constructible finite-Tor input is a finite extension of shifts of the generators, so invertibility holds on it. Empty schemes and zero generators start the same finite construction at zero.
